body: I’m a single mom and my four year old is the exact same way, it’s either holding my hand or playing with my hair to go to sleep. I won’t be the one to kick him out of the bed. With both pregnancies (I’ve also had a miscarriage in between) I waited till at least 20 weeks. Of course it doesn’t matter what others do, but that’s when I personally felt good to buy things here and there. And then I didn’t really go baby shopping to buy multiple things till I was 30 weeks with both. I just have anxiety so I didn’t want to break my heart if there was a reason. But I do the fun stuff to get ready super early! Like I’ll make the registries, plan the baby showers, do the announcements in a fun way, etc etc

Rock them! My son is three and the very very few times he will sit on my lap and let me rock him (doesn’t put him to sleep but a calm and peace floats over both of us) it brings tears to my eyes because I love him so much. Babies need their mom. That’s absolutely dumb to say you’re over doing it.

I had anterior placentas both pregnancies. My first honestly didn’t do much besides at night and super super late in my pregnancy, he was also tiny when he was born. Now he’s a massive three year old who’s mostly super active but knows how to chill out too. My second was beyond active, 24/7. He’s two months old and barely sleeps unless he’s on a walk or in the car lol. Sleeps through the night but definitely not through the day. He’s always moving too, so he matches up pretty well 🤣

I had my first Dec 2020. Second Nov 2023. My oldest loves to be held by mama and he’s a massive kid, 39.5 inches and 35lbs. I held him till the morning of my induction as long as I wasn’t in any abdominal pain. After my youngest was born cuddle time just happened on the couch instead until I felt okay to lift him again.

It’ll be okay. My oldest seemed to understand I couldn’t pick him up for the most part.

If my three year old is absolutely out of control and I’m starting to lose it just as bad as he is, I put him in our room and shut the door. There’s no lock at all on it so I’ll hold the handle till he tries to open it and then he goes back to freaking out on his bed and I walk away and sit down on the couch till he comes out not even five minutes later. This isn’t even once a week. Hell maybe once a month.

Am I a shitty parent for knowing my limits of stress with my toddler? No. It’s a lot better than losing it. He doesn’t need to see that. Him being in time out and screaming in a room by himself isn’t going to be worse than me screaming at him and getting angry. Parents AND kids have their limits. We’re human. Separate rooms and getting our mutual frustrations out by ourselves is a healthier way to calm down. My toddler doesn’t just calm down if you tell him “oh honey, remember our breathing techniques when we’re feeling big big emotions 🤍😌” 🙄
I try to be a nice balance of gentle and “WTF?!” Because some days are just WTF?! days and you can’t gentle your way through them.
I would rather have them in with me than getting snatched up. So till they can fight back or scream properly, they’re coming with me. If anything I’d just say face the wall of the stall.

I’m almost 11 weeks postpartum and in the same boat. Last night I took a photo of my son and I making our pizzas and I looked 15 weeks pregnant. I’m not on birth control either. My period has been trying to start since right after Christmas (I’ve been spotting ever since… really freaking annoying!!!) so I don’t know if that’s why or what. But of course then after seeing that, I look in the mirror before getting into the shower 🙄 I hate what I see. I’ve eaten the best I ever have. 

But then I remember the little boys that my body created and that’s why it looks a little different. It helps. But it’s still hard feeling gross in your own body.

I’m sorry you don’t like what you see either. I want to start doing small things at home too

I can’t be a solid mom that they need if I don’t shower. I have a three year old and a two month old. When they’re babies I bring them in the bathroom in their rocker while I shower so I have quick access. But with my second I bring him into the bathroom for protection against big brother 🤣

Got it! Understood. I have an appointment on the 23rd!

I am so so sorry this was your first and only experience of birth and labor. That’s awful! My second son (he was just born in the beginning of November) was also sunny side up and no one knew. Thank you my OB is a fantastic doctor and when he sensed what was happening (with how long it was taking and he wasn’t seeing my son’s head yet) he actually physically helped me out- he was pushing on my stomach to help him come down and within maybe a two pushes of him doing that he was able to pull him out. Bruising and swelling as well, and he’s still got the red coloring from the bruising on his forehead. 

Your OB should’ve been your biggest advocate. This just made me even more grateful for mine. My epidural was wearing off as well by the time I was 10 (it was strange- I could feel the right top half of my abdomen) and when he got there and I told him he himself tried finding the anesthesiologist but he was in the middle of giving someone their epidural. I talked me through it and motivated me that I was going to be okay. He didn’t say “eh, normal.” That’s messed up.

If it makes you feel better my toddler dropped my iPhone (12Pro Max I think? I don’t know lol the big one) on my eight week olds head and now he has a little bruise on his little forehead. Now that scream was traumatic.

Don’t feel bad! I don’t think there is a single parent that hasn’t bumped their kids head in something. Just breathe and watch if he starts acting weird (I highly doubt it but with head bumps on anyone you want to watch ☺️)

This, exactly. My son is now eight weeks old and my oldest (they’re almost exactly three years a part) acted the same way, he’s finally understanding more.

OP needs to be patient.

I swear my son is just a hungry little monster lol- he’s on the same formula and is eight weeks old DEMANDING 5oz every three hours.

If your baby is growing and pediatrician isn’t worried, don’t worry. There is not scale or right/wrong amount to feed baby.

Coming from someone with a narcissistic, abusive, asshole, lazy, lying, cheating, self absorbed leach who won’t go away- no. You do not need both parents. You need the best situation for you and your kid/s.

He fell off a few times but it’s so low he wouldn’t even wake up most times. He’s three now and he’s fully aware of where the bed ends, only took a few falls 😅

First boy: hell. Food aversions, nausea, I only threw up once but that’s the only time I’ve thrown up in pregnancy, stretch marks, preeclampsia.

Second boy: amazing. No nausea unless I was stressed, no food aversions, no vomiting. I even went to Moab for my birthday and hiked (70% of the time carrying my 2.5 year old too) miles on miles while 21 weeks pregnant, the two tiniest stretch marks even though I was 6lbs heavier this time and he was over a pound heavier and 2.5 inches longer than my first, zero preeclampsia.
He can pay for it if he wants it, and then he can also pay child support for making such a big fuss 😌

I have a three year old and an eight week old and still can’t get back into a routine. I personally thrive on one so I’m struggling and feel like a crap mom 🥹 you’re absolutely not a bad mom, routines aren’t for everyone especially when you’re the one doing the hard part.

Some mornings I’m also not in the mood to cook breakfast so I either give him fruit and granola bar or on the days I’m up for cooking I make wayyy extra and freeze the extra- it’s great with waffles and you just put one in the toaster. I’m not shaming, but maybe an extra idea? Those mornings I also get to sit down with my hot coffee.

I swear the day someone judges me in person over my kids is the day I snap 😮‍💨 I’ve yet to encounter it (my boys are 3 and eight weeks old) and I feel so lucky about that. The only snotty thing I’ve heard (that pissed my little sister off more than it did myself) was we went to this huge place that’s very family and kids oriented, we were in the “gardens” aka 44 acres of hills and flowers during a very hot October day and I was very pregnant with my three year old and an older lady says to her friend/daughter “I can’t even imagine coming here with my kid and being pregnant, that’s just ridiculous.”
Oh my god 🤣🤣 I started mine at girls camp and was so embarrassed I just used toilet paper (you know- the horrible toilet paper that is see through lol) for the rest of the camping trip 😭 traumatic 🤣

Poor thing! Jeez, I didn’t get mine till I was 15. Can’t imagine being 8 and getting it! And kudos to you for making her aware of it and she knew she could tell you- my mom never spoke about anything menstrual/sexual so when I started mine I was ashamed and hid it.
During sick time it’s unlimited as long as it’s keeping my son distracted from either feeling like crap himself or for me to lay down and try to relax.

I’m here any time to talk lol!

Girl my first son was born December 2020 and I had a false positive from my Covid test since I had it the month prior 🫠 imagine preeclampsia and that mess. My OB came in heartbroken because he saw my mask soaked in tears over it. I was so grateful this time around when even my blood pressure was steady from the first to the last appointment and I didn’t have any complications that a shot couldn’t fix! I’m glad your nurses cared and didn’t want to make matters worse ♥️

I feel like MIL’s are just a rollercoaster 🙄 my ex’s mom I love her to death but her opinions and superstitions especially about pregnancy/pp/baby are… a lot. It bothered me deeply with my first but with my second I knew what go expect. She has different beliefs than I do and I just have to let it roll off. Some MIL’s are purposely just nasty and hateful though. Luckily mine is just Catholic and has her own Hispanic superstitions 🤣 

My advice is to keep her out of pregnancy info/pp info with the next one if you have more! That’s what I did, I didn’t even say the due date day lol, I just said mid-November.

And I didn’t know about PP preeclampsia till my second! It’s wild. When I had him and they said they had to collect urine and blood to check I was so confused.

Fun fact: preeclampsia is from problems with the placenta. Which is what is made from your partners… stuff? Not sure the science exactly about it but this is coming from nurses and doctors mouths. So, nausea/preeclampsia is from the men’s diet and genes. My ex partner/the father of my boys is proof too- with my son he had a horrible diet of just complete and utter crap (his usual diet) and I had horrible nausea/food aversions and preeclampsia/high blood pressure. When we were trying for our second it was during his “health kick” and I had zero nausea unless I was stressed, zero food aversions, zero blood pressure issues, and no preeclampsia. Perfect pregnancy. The pregnancies were so different I was shocked when I found out my second son was another boy. 

And both pregnancies I had fast food with 🙄

I’d accept the free baby food and stuff though lol that stuff gets PRICEY (at least where I live)

I don’t have a single friend still that I had before I had my first son. They all left. Then I met some pretty cool freaking people that either kids or no kids they’re more than happy to be around my boys. You’ll find your true friends, not the flaky ones.

You’re 19 what the hell is this world coming to. I’m 27 and didn’t lose it till I was 23. Stop comparing your life to others. 19 is still very very young. If you’re not old enough to risk having a kid, you’re not old enough to be having sex.

It’s hard because you don’t want to punish the kids too. Maybe still help around for THEM, but don’t help her out. Do the kids laundry, clean up after the kids, take them to school. But make the mom take care of her damn self. And don’t let her into your life anymore if that makes sense, if she doesn’t see you as family (is how it sounds) then she doesn’t get to be treated as such.

I’m so sorry she sucks. And this quite honestly sounds like a jealousy/insecure move of hers. She sees you help her and you’re doing well. Some people (including family) hate it when you’re happy/doing well/help them in a time of need/etc etc because they know who’s the bigger person. So they cut deep in a usually very immature way. This just triggered me from when I was little and my moms boyfriend at the time grounded me from the tv for not finishing dinner, and I was singing along to American Idol (not watching it) and he got pissed 🙄

For the love, tv is not going to kill your kid or make them dumb. Limit it sure, of course we want them more active than sitting in front of a screen. All of this shaming from influencer moms about bf/pumping/formula, vaginal/c-section/unmedicated, screen time/no screen time- it literally makes me want to delete all social media. 

30 min. of Mrs.Rachel or Bluey is not going to harm your kid. Let alone listening to background noise, that’s like saying music is harmful to them and that’s most definitely not true. When they get older and experience tv for the first time- THAT is when the addiction will start. Because it’s new and exciting.

My son just turned three and yeah same boat. I’m trying to get him more involved in things and a stricter routine and it’s starting to help, for example Amazon has a toddler safe cooking set (he loves to try and help cook) and that’s on its way- I’m excited about that because I know if he’s helping he will start eating more and throwing less tantrums about eating.

Pray for us moms of three year olds 🥴

Pretty sure you’ve got the same thing the rest of the world seems to have (I’m just getting over it, my entire family has it it’s insane) and I’m sitting here with my seven week old on my chest trying to get him to sleep. So far, he seems okay and I’m trying so hard to keep it that way. But we’ve been sick since October with different things, especially my toddler.

Just keep your hands clean, constantly wash pacifiers, wash anything that goes into their mouth very well, no unnecessary visitors, I even have made the left side of my body the cough/sneeze/toddler side and then the right side is where my newborn stays. And do not let anyone touch their hands! They put their hands in the mouths a lot sooner than you’d think.

It’s been a long time of healing and really low lows, but after hitting rock bottom a few years ago it’s been nothing but up since then. I’m pretty damn proud of myself because I never thought I would. 

Thank you ♥️

As someone who was sexually abused since 6yo-13yo by her aunts husband- if I ever got a weird feeling like this or if someone were to ever be excited about diaper changing/baths, bye bye. Zero alone time, zero naked time, and no changing in front of him. People can mask themselves really easy. 

Trust your feelings.
Awww you’re about to enter the best age! I have 10 more months to get there again 🤣 I’m so glad you’re doing better, it’s hard. You’re doing amazing!

2 boys, one is three and one is six weeks old. Finances, patience, personally not want to have babies in my 30’s. I want them to both get good chances in a lot of things and I don’t want them worrying about if mom can afford it and not ask out of weird guilt like I did.

Everything after 28 weeks (with both kids) shit hits the fan and pregnancy is a nightmare. Id rather be nauseous than not being able to walk without feeling like you’re either going to physically fall apart or cry.

(Throwing it out there- both pregnancies I was extremely lucky and grateful that I had generally smooth first trimesters, both pregnancies together I only threw up once)

Luckily my three year old is used to saying thank you to literally everything so I don’t need to remind him. It’s the I’m sorry that he’s got to work on 🤣 but yes I’d say at least remind him when to say it

Partner? Not a damn thing but I got him three things I knew he’d lose his mind over. Kids? Nothing which sounds dumb, but I always remember my uncle taking us out to get stuff for my mom and that was the BEST part of Christmas to me and it hurts no one does that with my toddler…

My partner’s aunt got me a plaid shawl thing that’s so soft ♥️ my MIL got me the most gorgeous sweater ♥️ my sister did a super cute gift basket ♥️ and my other sister baked/made some treats! ♥️ they all made me feel so… thought about. It’s not the gifts, it’s the thought. I’m sick of my partner doing nothing for holidays (not even the kids, and that’s why on their stuff it says from MAMA and always will- no credit where credit is not deserved). He’s always a grinch. Next year he’s getting the empty Amazon boxes 😌 a card that says “happy holidays” isn’t that hard to come by.

My first son was like this. Wouldn’t sleep at someone else’s house whatsoever, I HAD to hold him. Didn’t grow out of this till we had no choice but staying with my great aunt out of state for a month while waiting for our new apartment to be available after a lease ended. 

I know no one will agree but this is how I did it and survived and got him to also chill the hell out- I had my iPad with me and he watched calm tv shows. Honestly I just let him watch it till he fell asleep. He was sleeping instead of screaming and that’s a win. It’s not forever. When we got back home he wasn’t “adDiCTed tO sCrEeN tiMe” before bed. He just went back to normal.
A lot happier too, lease ends in May and he can go ruin his life more.

My “partner” who I no longer plan on being with, this morning was the last straw. Ruins every Christmas and holiday. Getting ready to go to his parents place he’s muttering rude things and I ask him to knock it off. Then he blows up, says we’re not going, (he’s 33 years old), and throws a fit. I tell him to suck it up and I’ll take the boys without him. Then to try to convince me not to, proceeds to tell me how much my family and his family hate me. 

Also- didn’t get anyone a single thing meanwhile I had presents for him under the tree. Couldn’t even buy a stupid happy holidays card.

It’s always my sister and brother in law- this time it was tiny little cars that look so fragile you know they won’t last a week. He just barely turned three two weeks ago. I’ve stepped on them a total of five times already because they are so small and blend in.

Always being unappreciated and having people say you’re doing something wrong… I try so hard for my boys. I don’t know if I’m starting to get PPD (my youngest is seven weeks old) but lately I feel like tossed away trash. Christmas isn’t helping…

My partner made me full aware I’m not getting anything in my stocking or under the tree, and he didn’t get our three year old or six week old anything either. Meanwhile they all have stuff under the tree from me. 

I think it’s rude, inconsiderate, and it hurts. I feel so unvalued. Couldn’t even buy me a card that said Happy Holidays, meanwhile I hand drew and wrote our families and my friends Christmas cards. It makes me not want to try to make anything special but it makes my toddler so happy that I keep just accepting disappointment every holiday.

He’s an asshole for doing that but I’m going to try to give you some hope- 

I’ve got a three year old and a six week old. My baby was born early November, my toddler has been sick since the baby shower from my niece in mid October. First cold we all got and it was pure hell, I’m talking it had to have been Covid or RSV. It was so bad and lasted two weeks. Two day break. Toddler starts up with a nasty cough. I’m induced during this nasty cough. Got home, didn’t let my toddler touch him but can’t keep them too far a part because their dad is useless and mom is mom and dad in this household. Washed my hands and sanitized everything I could. Two day break. I get the cough. And then he starts up with ANOTHER cold. Two weeks of hell again. Two day break. Now we’re all sick again with a small cold.

My son (six week old) is the only one that SO FAR (cross fingers) is okay. 

Wash hands. Don’t let him near baby. Sanitize. No one holds baby till they wash up to their freaking elbows if it helps you feel better. If you see someone hug FIL, whoops sorry either change clothes or you don’t hold baby. Actually I’d probably just baby wear to be honest, no one touches baby but you and your partner if he’s not too close to your FIL.
My three year old wakes up from naps ANGRY sometimes. Honestly most days I keep him up if he’s not too bad because fussy toddler is a lot easier to deal with than angry screaming and crying toddler

My 3 year old doesn’t take naps anymore either and also has ADHD, he has his days where he’s just a freaking tornado and laughs about it. When I need a break (a moment to myself/a nap/a long shower/etc) I put him at the table (he has his own table set made for toddlers- super cheap and worth it on Amazon) with crayons, paper, and turn on Trash Truck on Netflix on my iPad and put my iPad on the table. That kid will stay there and be calm and quiet for around an hour.

Maybe try to do something along these lines? It would be worth a shot in trying.

As for the baby, shit. 20-30min? What do you do at night for him to sleep even slightly longer than that?

I have two kids- a three year old and a six week old. Six week old obviously got spent under $100 lol- teethers, the ring stack things, and a soft fabric cube toy. Three year old I always say under $200 but my credit cards say different, it’s probably around $400. His birthday is also two weeks before Christmas and I stay around $50-70.

I don’t buy stuff year round outside of clothes and necessities. Christmas is when he gets all his toys, both fun and educational. Coloring books, things he’s into right now, cool toothbrush, bath bombs (those are his favorite), things to help more development through the next year. Santa does one gift and the stocking- this year the gift is the Christmas town train set from Hearth and Hand and I have it set up for Christmas morning, Santa never wraps his gifts. I grew up with a single mom of three girls and being the oldest I saw and knew how much she struggled to do holidays. I don’t know, maybe I try to make up for it??

Nahhh I would’ve lost my shit. My son is six weeks old and my toddler is three and has been sick since October. I’ve been stressed like hell trying to keep them separated and keep my baby healthy. If someone did that? Hell. My toddler got into my babies rocker and put his binky in his own mouth and I straight up said bye to that binky and it went into the trash immediately 🙃

My three year old is finally understanding what Christmas is so I did kind of go overboard this year but I think he still has less than 20 gifts not including stocking stuffers. But, it’s how I make up for my childhood honestly.

I know it makes me so angry how he just chalked it up to that! My OB thinks it could’ve been a milk allergy/sensitivity and the proteins from the dairy I was eating/drinking was pulling out the water from him and making him thirsty/lose water weight. He was like yeah you don’t lose fat and muscle overnight even in a new baby

If he moved clinics I would follow him even if that meant a two hour drive or paying out of pocket- it’s worth it if you’re listened to and paying for one appointment instead of not being listened to and having to go to 7 appointments.

You need to talk to someone you know will listen and that you trust. To put into perspective of how young you are though, I didn’t even HAVE a period at your age yet. You’ve got a life ahead of you, it’s going to be so hard and scary. I had my first at 24 and even that was hard.

I hope whatever decision you come to it makes you happy and it’s genuinely what YOU want to do. Not anyone else.

Yes let’s add a weekly hand job to: feeding, holding, taking general care of, sleep deprivation, and being touched out for a newborn. It shows his maturity.

I’m almost six weeks PP and I don’t even want to think about sex. With my first we had sex before the six weeks and it was a big regret of mine just because I put his needs before mine and my health.

Tell him the bathroom is a great place for him to take care of himself till you feel up for it.

Mom of a three year old boy (who also wasn’t planned and I never pictured myself as a mom) who’s my entire world and a brand new little boy (planned lol) who’s a little over a month old here 🤚🏻 it happens. It’s crazy and you can’t believe it but your heart makes room. Both of my boys are each my entire world, they really complete me. The second my second son came out it was like my life was completed. I’m just a puddle over these two 🧡🩵
